name: American Sign Language
notes: Six classes: two intermediate-level language classes and four electives.
ASLA 101 and ASLA 102 should be completed before declaring the minor; they are prerequisites, not part of the six.
At least two of the four electives must have an ASLA course number - modeled as its own group.
No more than two of these courses can be conducted in spoken English - not auto-enforced.
ASLA 106 requires a permission code from the program advisor; ASLA 102-106 and 200-level courses require a preceding all-ASL course or instructor permission. Not auto-enforced.
